# Lexicon NSIDs

This index covers 59 NSIDs: 55 record collections and 4 definition-only namespaces. Each page resolves refs, field shapes, constraints, and known values from the source JSON.

> `knownValues` are open suggestions in the AT Protocol lexicon model. Clients should preserve unfamiliar string values.

## Catalog types

| NSID                                                                                    | Kind     | Definitions | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`app.graycard.catalog.cameraType`](./app.graycard.catalog.cameraType.md)               | `record` | 1           | Camera model/type (e.g. Nikon F2). Instances reference this record. Projected into a photo's EXIF (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif) make/model when associated with a photo.                                                                                                                                              |
| [`app.graycard.catalog.chemistryType`](./app.graycard.catalog.chemistryType.md)         | `record` | 9           | A photographic-chemistry product. | [`app.graycard.catalog.devRecipe`](./app.graycard.catalog.devRecipe.md)                 | `record` | 3           | A development recipe: the time(s) to develop a given film at a given exposure index in a given developer/dilution, sourced from a manufacturer datasheet. Bundled curated recipes and user-saved personal recipes share this shape.                                                                                    |

## Core

| NSID                                                  | Kind          | Definitions | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`app.graycard.artifact`](./app.graycard.artifact.md) | `record`      | 1           | A concrete workflow input or output, such as a RAW file, negative strip, print, or video clip. Artifact records form the nodes of a provenance graph; process stages connect those nodes and may accept multiple inputs, such as a negative and a mask used to make a print.        |
| [`app.graycard.defs`](./app.graycard.defs.md)         | `definitions` | 39          | Fixed-point number scaled by 1,000,000. Used for values projected into a photo's EXIF record (e.g. social.grain.photo.exif), which stores numerics at this fixed scale. Prefer #measure for graycard-native quantities.                                                             |
| [`app.graycard.setup`](./app.graycard.setup.md)       | `record`      | 1           | A publicly discoverable photography setup. Opting in writes one of these to the user's own repo; its `registry` field links to a well-known discovery anchor so a shared backlink index (Constellation) can enumerate every published setup across the network without any backend. |

## Metering

| NSID                                                                    | Kind          | Definitions | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`app.graycard.meter.calibration`](./app.graycard.meter.calibration.md) | `record`      | 1           | A calibration profile for a metering instrument — most importantly a phone acting as a meter, where each camera module and sensor path needs its own correction. Stored in the repo so profiles roam across app installs. A reading references the profile that was applied to it, keeping every value auditable.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`app.graycard.meter.defs`](./app.graycard.meter.defs.md)               | `definitions` | 8           | How light was gathered for a reading. Incident measures light falling on the subject (dome integrates 3D form; flat disc measures a plane); reflected measures light returning from the scene, either wide-field or through spot optics.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [`app.graycard.meter.reading`](./app.graycard.meter.reading.md)         | `record`      | 1           | A light-meter reading containing an observed photometric quantity, observation geometry, instrument, and optional exposure solution. It supports phone meters, handheld ambient or spot meters, and imported flash-meter readings. geometry, lightKind, and createdAt are required; other fields may be added afterward. ev100, illuminance, and luminance store measurements, while exposure stores the displayed solution and its compensation, filters, and reciprocity adjustment. |

Nodes and edges reference this record. schemaVersion pins the panproto theory for round-trip migration.                                                                                                                                                                    |
| [`app.graycard.scene.node`](./app.graycard.scene.node.md)         | `record`      | 1           | A typed vertex in a scene graph (panproto Entity/Event/Region/etc.). Its type references an ontology term; attrs carries an open attribute bundle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [`app.graycard.scene.ontology`](./app.graycard.scene.ontology.md) | `record`      | 2           | A shareable vocabulary for scene graphs. nodeTypes defines concepts and edgeTypes defines relations. Scene node and edge records hold observed instances; domainIncludes and rangeIncludes summarize the node types seen in those records. An observed instance relation does not create a type-level axiom. schemaVersion identifies the Panproto theory used by the vocabulary. |
| [`app.graycard.scene.region`](./app.graycard.scene.region.md)     | `record`      | 1           | A grounded region on a photo (the panproto 'grounds' target). Supports bounding boxes, rotated boxes, polygons, raster/RLE masks, points, keypoints, and 3D cuboids so any CV output can attach to a scene node.                                                                                                                                                                  |
